metadata.title: [Paper title] — LLM session transcripts (holotype archive)
metadata.description:
holotype paper-bundle deposit supporting the publication: [Paper title].

This archive contains the verbatim host-CLI JSONL transcripts of the LLM sessions referenced in the paper, a per-session SHA-256 manifest, and a standalone verification procedure (VERIFY.md) that requires only stock Unix tools (shasum, jq).

Each session can be verified by recomputing the SHA-256 of its transcript.jsonl and comparing against the manifest's sha256 field. The bundle's master tarball SHA-256 is provided in the accompanying .sha256 sidecar.

Produced by holotype v[X.Y.Z] (manifest schema v[N]). The holotype tool is open-source at https://github.com/PEEKPerformer/holotype under the MIT license.
metadata.notes: Verification procedure inside the bundle's VERIFY.md. Requires only stock Unix tools (shasum, jq), no holotype installation needed.
